evidence: a derived relation's fields must be `rows.shape.<field>`
metric: 15430 edges with empty class; fix to rows.shape.pair_key / rows.shape.evidence_class; then none 8524 / literature_only 4379 / high 2527
observation: Declaring a derived relation field as value_expression("") makes the planner emit a constant projection, so every value arrives empty and no error is raised; the same code worked on raw-source because there the aggregate module replaced the SQL body wholesale. All 15,430 edges carried an empty class until the fields were declared as rows.shape.<field>.

title: A constant projection silently emptied a derived field
